overview_description.description: Liazon is an online benefits store that operates private benefits exchange for large and small businesses. Its flagship product, the Bright Choices Exchange, helps employers manage their health care costs by setting predictable budgets through a defined contribution funding strategy while guiding employees to purchase better coverage of health, dental, vision, life, disability, and other benefits. Launched in 2007, the platform’s operations are based in Buffalo, New York.
